Visible on the plate: fried breaded chicken (maybe a cutlet or pieces), a little slaw on top, and 2 slices of bacon.

Rough estimates:
- Fried chicken, about 150 g at roughly 250 kcal per 100 g, so about 375 kcal.
- Slaw, about 40 g, so about 50 kcal.
- Bacon, 2 slices at about 8 g each, so about 85 kcal.

That gives about 210 g and about 510 kcal.
